correctness.rationale: The proof begins from the exact Pfaffian multiplicity/projective-degree product. A factorial regrouping gives the adjacent two-step ratio with denominator \((2s)!\) times a Catalan number. Taking the quotient of consecutive adjacent ratios produces the stated curvature formula. The curvature sign polynomial has an exact strictly negative two-step difference on the full admissible domain, proving at most one sign change. The bulk limit is obtained directly by division by \(n^4\) and yields the boundary \(\theta=1/\sqrt{17}\). The bundled exact checker replays all identities through \(n=120\) but is not used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Pfaffian rank loci are one of the three classical matrix-rank geometries, alongside ordinary and symmetric determinantal varieties. Projective degree is their fundamental enumerative invariant. The theorem gives the exact local curvature of the entire rank-degree profile, proves a one-transition law, and identifies a sharp bulk phase boundary. The fact that the skew-symmetric family independently lands on the same \(1/\sqrt{17}\) boundary as the nearby ordinary and symmetric matrix families is structurally informative and creates a concrete comparison target for a unified explanation.
